# 2027 Out-Of-Cycle Changes

*SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: invented text that only mimics the page structure of a documentation changelog. It is not vendor documentation.*

2027 out-of-cycle changes to the sample API.

### October 22, 2027

### Unified flag on campaign groups

*Affects every version.*

The `is_unified` field on campaign groups is now available in the sample API.

### September 14, 2027

### Optional budget field on ad sets

*Affects every version.*

Ad sets can now omit the `daily_budget` field when a lifetime budget is set. Existing requests are unaffected.

### August 3, 2027

### Video placement option

- A new placement value is available for video ads.
- Unknown placement values are still rejected with an error.

### June 29, 2027

### Targeting field renamed

*Affects every version.*

The `geo_include` targeting field was renamed to `geo_locations`. The old name keeps working until the next major version.

### February 17, 2027

### Reach estimates

- Reach estimates are now returned for lifetime budgets.
